lessons.claim: Leave the physical system out of the run_id hash and completely different systems get the same run_id, prepare_outdir skips it as 'an already completed run', and the old system's result is reported as the new system's. Measured: the 1-B spec had no physical system, so despite d 5µm→0.5µm, η by 62x and a changed ρ_p (a 16.1x difference in τ_B) the run_id stayed identical at soft-r3-2d-A-sweep__A100__27f70deab9. A content address has to cover 'everything that fixes the physics' and at the same time exclude documentation, sources and derived values (both are needed).
